# Datasource: `demo_database` — 8 model(s)
- `customers` (2 cols; joins: `orders`, `tweets`)
- `items` (4 cols; joins: `orders`, `products`)
- `orders` (9 cols; joins: `customers`, `items`, `stores`)
- `products` (5 cols; joins: `items`, `supplies`)
- `stores` (4 cols; joins: `orders`)
- `supplies` (5 cols; joins: `products`)
- `time_spine` (1 cols; joins: _(none)_)
- `tweets` (4 cols; joins: `customers`)

## demo_database.products
# `products`
Columns: sku, name, type, price, description
Measures: product_count, avg_price
Aggregations: dollars
Joins to: _(none)_

---

## demo_database.supplies
# `supplies`
Columns: id, name, cost, perishable, sku
Measures: total_supply_cost, avg_unit_cost
Aggregations: dollars
Joins to: products

## demo_database.products
# Model: `products`

- **data_source:** `demo_database`
- **sql_table:** `products`
- **row_count:** 10

## Columns (5)

| name | type | primary_key | sql | allowed_aggregations | label | description | sampled |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| sku | TEXT | yes | sku | all | — | — | — |
| name | TEXT | — | name | all | Product | Product name. | adele-ade, chai and mighty, doctor stew, flame impala, for richer or pourover , mel-bun, nutellaphone who dis?, tangaroo, the krautback, vanilla ice |
| type | TEXT | — | type | all | Category | Product category. | beverage, jaffle |
| price | INT | — | price | all | Price (cents) | List price, in cents. | 400 .. 1400 |
| description | TEXT | — | description | all | Description | Product description. | a kiwi and lime agua fresca, hello from the other side of thirst, daily selection of single estate beans for a delicious hot pourover, house-made beef stew jaffle, iced coffee with house-made french vanilla syrup, lamb and pork bratwurst with house-pickled cabbage sauerkraut and mustard, mango and tangerine smoothie, melon and minced beef bao, in a jaffle, savory and sweet, nutella and banana jaffle, oatmilk chai latte with protein boost, pulled pork and pineapple al pastor marinated in ghost pepper sauce, kevin parker's favorite! |

## Measures (2)

| name | formula | label | description | meta |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| product_count | sku:count_distinct | Products | Number of distinct products. | {"format": {"precision": 0, "symbol": null, "type": "integer"}} |
| avg_price | price:avg / 100.0 | Average Price | Average list price, in dollars. | {"format": {"precision": 2, "symbol": "$", "type": "currency"}} |

## Aggregations (1)

| name | formula | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dollars | SUM({value}) / 100.0 | Sum of an integer-cents column expressed in dollars. |

## Joins (2)

| target_model | join_pairs | cardinality |
| --- | --- | --- |
| items | sku = sku | one_to_many |
| supplies | sku = sku | one_to_many |

## Data Profile SQL

```sql
SELECT
  products.name AS "products.name",
  products.type AS "products.type",
  COUNT(*) AS "products._count",
  CAST(AVG(products.price) AS DOUBLE) AS "products.price_avg",
  COUNT(DISTINCT products.description) AS "products.description_count_distinct"
FROM products AS products
GROUP BY
  products.name,
  products.type
LIMIT 3
```

## Data Profile

| name | type | _count | price_avg | description_count_distinct |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| flame impala | jaffle | 1 | 1400.0 | 1 |
| mel-bun | jaffle | 1 | 1200.0 | 1 |
| tangaroo | beverage | 1 | 600.0 | 1 |

## Learnings (1)

- **Mjaffle-money-in-cents** (`demo_database.products.price`): Money is stored as **integer cents**. On `orders` the columns `subtotal`, `tax_paid`, and `order_total` are cents; so are `products.price` and `supplies.cost`. Do not `sum` these raw columns for a dollar figure. Use the `dollars` aggregation (`order_total:dollars`) or the pre-built dollar measures (`total_revenue`, `net_sales`, `tax_collected`, `avg_order_value`), which divide by 100.

---

## demo_database.supplies
# Model: `supplies`

- **data_source:** `demo_database`
- **sql_table:** `supplies`
- **row_count:** 65

## Columns (5)

| name | type | primary_key | sql | allowed_aggregations | label | description | sampled |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| id | TEXT | yes | id | all | — | — | — |
| name | TEXT | — | name | all | Supply | Supply name. | 16oz compostable clear cup, 16oz compostable clear lid, biodegradable straw, bread, compostable cutlery - knife, cutlery - fork, napkin, serving boat, cheese, coffee, banana, beef stew, chai mix, french vanilla syrup, ghost pepper sauce, house-pickled cabbage sauerkraut, kiwi, lamb and pork bratwurst, lime, mango |
| cost | INT | — | cost | all | Unit Cost (cents) | Cost per unit, in cents. | 4 .. 234 |
| perishable | BOOLEAN | — | perishable | all | Perishable | Whether the supply is perishable. | False, True |
| sku | TEXT | — | sku | all | Product | Product this supply is used for. Not unique: a product has several supply rows (one per component). | JAF-003, JAF-004, JAF-005, JAF-001, JAF-002, BEV-002, BEV-001, BEV-003, BEV-005, BEV-004 |

## Measures (2)

| name | formula | label | description | meta |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| total_supply_cost | cost:dollars | Total Supply Cost | Total supply cost, in dollars. | {"format": {"precision": 2, "symbol": "$", "type": "currency"}} |
| avg_unit_cost | cost:avg / 100.0 | Avg Unit Cost | Average supply unit cost, in dollars. | {"format": {"precision": 2, "symbol": "$", "type": "currency"}} |

## Aggregations (1)

| name | formula | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dollars | SUM({value}) / 100.0 | Sum of an integer-cents column expressed in dollars. |

## Joins (1)

| target_model | join_pairs | cardinality |
| --- | --- | --- |
| products | sku = sku | many_to_one |

## Data Profile SQL

```sql
SELECT
  supplies.name AS "supplies.name",
  supplies.perishable AS "supplies.perishable",
  COUNT(*) AS "supplies._count",
  CAST(AVG(supplies.cost) AS DOUBLE) AS "supplies.cost_avg",
  COUNT(DISTINCT supplies.sku) AS "supplies.sku_count_distinct"
FROM supplies AS supplies
GROUP BY
  supplies.name,
  supplies.perishable
LIMIT 3
```

## Data Profile

| name | perishable | _count | cost_avg | sku_count_distinct |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| serving boat | False | 5 | 11.0 | 5 |
| lime | True | 1 | 13.0 | 1 |
| compostable cutlery - knife | False | 5 | 7.0 | 5 |

## Learnings (1)

- **Mjaffle-money-in-cents** (`demo_database.supplies.cost`): Money is stored as **integer cents**. On `orders` the columns `subtotal`, `tax_paid`, and `order_total` are cents; so are `products.price` and `supplies.cost`. Do not `sum` these raw columns for a dollar figure. Use the `dollars` aggregation (`order_total:dollars`) or the pre-built dollar measures (`total_revenue`, `net_sales`, `tax_collected`, `avg_order_value`), which divide by 100.

args.message: Flame impala has the highest gross margin per unit: $10.57, which is 0.755 of its price. It sells for $14.00, and its supplies cost $3.43 per unit. I got the per-unit supply cost by adding up all of the product's supply rows; each row is one component. Price and cost are both stored in cents. Next highest is nutellaphone who dis? at $9.79.
